svg.title: CLA · T8 — Failure domains

text.tspan: Six failures, each the T1 spine re-coloured, then what the occupant actually experiences. Rows of STD-006 §2's matrix, applied to this house. CLA-BUILD-001 r1 · 2026-10-06
The one honest limit (STD-006 §2.2): manual-first needs electricity. Bus B is
R06 and R07 go dark but stay reported. The AV circuit and every other room
Every box falls back to autonomy within 3 s. On return COMP reconciles, it
The boxes keep their RS-485 link to COMP. What goes is everything that rides
Ethernet: panels, cameras, Matter over WiFi.
The hub is a hub for cables, not for logic: each box has its own RS-485
channel and the pass-through is passive. Downstream boxes never notice.
Common cause: stacking puts BASE and the hub in one cupboard. Were the
assured pack there too, egress would go with them — which is why it moves to
